activity.notes: Abd el-Krim was the principal leader of the Riffian state-building project conventionally known as the Republic of the Rif, established in September 1921 and defeated by the joint Spanish-French campaign in 1926. The polity is recorded as his own political community rather than the Spanish or French colonial authorities he fought.

sources.title: Catalans and Rifis during the Wilsonian Moment: The Quest for Self-Determination in the Post-Versailles World
sources.citation_text: Cambridge scholarship identifies Muhammad ibn Abd al-Karim El-Khattabi (Abd el-Krim) as the leader who proclaimed the Rif Republic and describes the political structure created in the Rif on 18 September 1921.
